Very good food
Aug 2026 • Business
I recently had the pleasure of ordering from and visiting Mom’s Indian Cuisine, and I would love to share my experience. If you are looking for authentic, flavorful, and comforting Indian food in Ho Chi Minh City, this is definitely a restaurant worth trying.

From the beginning, the experience felt warm and personal. The owner and staff were very friendly, welcoming, and attentive. They genuinely care about their customers and make an effort to make everyone feel comfortable. That personal touch makes Mom’s Indian Cuisine feel different from many other restaurants.

The food was the highlight of my experience. The flavors were rich, aromatic, and full of the spices that make Indian cuisine so special. The curries were flavorful without being overwhelming, and the food tasted freshly prepared. The butter chicken was especially delicious and is something I would recommend to anyone visiting for the first time. The combination of creamy curry with naan was excellent.

The garlic naan was also very good. It was soft, flavorful, and a perfect choice for enjoying with the curries. I also enjoyed the rice dishes, which paired very well with the different gravies and sauces. The restaurant offers a variety of Indian dishes, so there is something for people who enjoy vegetarian food as well as for those who prefer chicken or other options.

One thing I particularly enjoyed was the green sauce. It had a fresh and flavorful taste and added an extra dimension to the meal. Small details like this make the dining experience more enjoyable.

I also appreciate that the restaurant is willing to listen to customers. If you prefer your food less spicy or have a particular preference, you can communicate with the staff and they are happy to help when possible. This is especially useful for people who are trying Indian food for the first time or who prefer milder flavors.

The portions were satisfying, and I found the prices reasonable considering the quality and freshness of the food. Whether you are eating alone, having a meal with friends, or ordering food for your family, Mom’s Indian Cuisine has plenty of choices.

The restaurant has a cozy and simple atmosphere. It may not be a huge restaurant, but that actually adds to its charm. The experience feels more personal and relaxed. Parking and access may depend on the time of day, so it can be useful to plan ahead, especially during busy periods.

Overall, my experience with Mom’s Indian Cuisine was very positive. The combination of tasty Indian food, friendly service, reasonable prices, and a welcoming atmosphere makes it a place I would be happy to visit again.

If you enjoy Indian cuisine in Ho Chi Minh City, I recommend giving Mom’s Indian Cuisine a try. Whether you are craving butter chicken and naan, vegetarian dishes, rice, masala tea, or simply want to explore Indian flavors, there are many options to choose from.

Thank you to the team at Mom’s Indian Cuisine for the warm hospitality and delicious food. I look forward to coming back again and trying more dishes from the menu. I would happily recommend this restaurant to friends, family, and anyone looking for a friendly place to enjoy Indian food in Ho Chi Minh City.
